page.overview:
Who is Conessa Berg?

is an undead frost giant jarl of Eiselcross in northern Wildemount.

At some point after 300 PD Conessa became jarl, ruling over her people from an enormous and beautiful ice castle.

She was very interested in the ruins and relics from the fallen city of Aeor, so she started collecting them, and others brought similar artifacts in order to please her. Around 635 PD one of those objects was brought to the fortress, but its unstable nature caused an arcane burst, with necromantic and cold energies transforming every giant inside the castle into rime-infused zombies.

Conessa and her subjects stayed in their frozen home, that would end up being called the Fortress of the Dead Jarl because of her, but not many knew about their current undead existence. However, in or before 836 PD, something caused a breach in the ice fortress, allowing some of the giants to escape their home and start attacking people in Eiselcross.
